text_block_list.text:
"The dream of victory was not realized. 
...The curtain fell on a Derby that ended 
far too soon. Each harbored their own 
feelings—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... It's over... Our one and 
only runway...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... This is the best I can do right 
now...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how it looked to you. But... 
but, you know...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The running I picture isn't anything like 
this! The 'White Lightning' is meant to be 
way... way more than this..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
choice_data_list: Still, that was a great run.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
......Thanks. Still, I really am "unlucky" 
to the core, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Born without fortune or a strong body... 
Yet she overcame it all with sheer grit, 
only to meet with such misfortune right 
before the Derby...
choice_data_list:
Still, it's wonderful that you were able 
to participate at all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, yer right! If I didn't think of it 
that way, I'd never make it through...!

A roar that could have been tears or pure 
rage. Tamamo Cross's bitter regret pierced 
through the skies of Fuchu just like a 
clap of thunder.
